elements.note: The balustrade is fixed with a steel plate and reinforcing bars 'ตามแบบ' -- no plate size or bar diameter is given on this sheet.

warnings: *** THE RAMP RISE IS PRINTED HERE: 0.28 M. *** A-18 gave only the 4.00 m run and the two floor levels, so the gradient had to be computed; this sheet prints the 0.28 dimension directly, confirming 0.28 / 4.00 = 1:14.3. The A-18 flag gradient_computed_not_printed is resolved -- though even here no ratio is written out.

*** THE RAMP HAS A DOUBLE HANDRAIL: TWO ø 1 1/2" GRAB RAILS AT 0.90 AND 0.75 M *** plus four ø 1" infill rails at 0.60 / 0.45 / 0.25 / 0.10, six rails in all at 0.15 m centres. A-03 only asks for a rail at 0.80 m above the ramp; the built detail brackets that with rails at 0.75 and 0.90 and adds low infill so a wheel or a stick cannot pass under.

A 100 x 150 mm wheel-guard kerb ('ยกขอบ สูง 10 ซม กว้าง 15 ซม') runs both sides, and every exposed concrete arris is rounded to R20 -- marked five times. Both are accessibility details that only appear at this scale.
The ramp is 0.90 m clear between the kerbs, 1.30 m overall.
The balustrade fixing is specified only as 'ยึดด้วยแผ่นเหล็ก พร้อมเหล็กเส้นตามแบบ' with no plate size or bar diameter anywhere -- flagged fixing_size_deferred.
Both sections are 1:25 and both are called from the A-18 plan.
